title: Author countries
statementMd:
List each country that has at least one author.

Expected columns: `country`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM authors;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
